adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the Calendar interface to `createEvent(event: CalendarEvent, credentialId: number)` (packages/types/Calendar.d.ts) and CalendarManager now calls `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)` (packages/core/CalendarManager.ts). However Office365CalendarService still defines `async createEvent(event: CalendarEvent)` and selects the calendar URL based on only the first destination calendar (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []` then `/me/calendars/${mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId}/events`) (packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts). With collective events, `evt.destinationCalendar` becomes an array containing multiple hosts’ destination calendars (packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts), so using only the first entry can mismatch the token/credential being used for later hosts, causing requests to target the wrong calendar under the wrong credential (likely 404) and preventing events from landing in the intended host’s Outlook calendar.
